sources.notes: Directly inspected Japanese 18+ PC walkthrough explicitly made WITHOUT the difficulty patch. Choice-by-choice columns for Keisuke/Rin/Motomi/Shiki/Nano, specific BAD alternatives and post-clear unlocks, correct ScriptVersion1.00 Keisuke opening.

sources.title: 咎狗の血 PC版攻略（HalfAdder）
sources.notes: Independently directly inspected complete Japanese PC walkthrough with all main outcomes, normal choices and conditional-choice markers. This page was updated to accommodate ScriptVersion1.01 difficulty patch: its Keisuke opening uses やっぱりダメだ; crucially its note explicitly says first choice ・・・・・ in 1.01 suppresses BAD alternatives, and says other choices are unchanged. For unpatched 1.00 target opening the separate B component blgame.hatenablog.com confirms 「……」 alongside primary unpatched Set A. The B source set thus uses both pages for 1.00.

sources.title: 攻略◆咎狗の血（オリジナルPC攻略復刻）
sources.notes: Independently inspectable original-era Japanese PC-route/affinity notes, restored in 2017 from the author's 2000s-era site. Explicitly says difficulty adjustment patch is unnecessary and gives original unpatched Keisuke opening 「……」 and his two BAD outcomes alongside GOOD; reconfirms first-run Shiki unlock after Rin, n unlock after other four GOODs, Kiriwar/Gunji executioner split and all other character entries. B is a composite independent verification set (HalfAdder full PC steps + this independent original unpatched witness). Neither is a translation/derivative of Set A.
